text: My daily routine is simple but effective. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I begin work at nine and stay focused until five in the afternoon. Around six, I go for a run or visit the gym to stay fit. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a show to relax. I try to sleep before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel organised, energetic, and ready for each new day.
